name: Berlin Conference
short_desc: Colonial powers agree rules for trade and territorial claims in Africa at a conference that excludes African representatives.
date_note: Held from 15 November 1884 to 26 February 1885. The conference set rules for colonial claims and navigation; it did not draw every African border or begin all European colonization of Africa.
notes: Added after a catalog gap review on 24 October 2026. Adds a consequential colonial framework linking African history with nineteenth-century imperial expansion. Evidence and date rationale: Held in Berlin from 15 November 1884 to 26 February 1885.
